definitions.explanation: A question word asking about things, actions, or matters. One of the most fundamental question words.

examples.notes: 何 is read as なん before です

examples.japanese: {何|なに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: What do you want to eat?

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{飲|の}みます→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: Would you like something to drink?

examples.japanese: {何|なに}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{買|か}わないで→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りました→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I went home without buying anything, but it was fun just looking around the shops.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
- なに: before most particles ({何|なに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, {何|なに}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧, ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧, ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧)
- なん: before です and だ, before ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, and with counters (⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}, ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧, ⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧: something (⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat something)
- ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧ + negative: nothing (⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{食|た}べない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat nothing)
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: anything, whatever

WATCH OUT:
In speech {何|なん}で usually means "why" ({何|なん}で⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？ "Why didn't you come?"). To ask "by what means," use {何|なに}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ ({何|なに}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧？ "How are you getting there?").

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧: who
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧: where
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧: when
